English: The World Health Organization (WHO) recommends a CD4 cell count before starting antiretroviral therapy (ART) to detect advanced HIV disease, and routine viral load (VL) testing following ART initiation to detect treatment failure.
Luganda: Ekitongole ky’Ebyobulamu mu Nsi Yonna (WHO) kisemba okubala obutaffaali bwa CD4 ng’eddagala eriweweeza ku HIV (ART) terinnatandikibwa okuzuula obulwadde bwa HIV obukuze, n’okukeberanga omuwendo gw’akawuka (VL) nga ART atandikiddwa okuzuula okulemwa kw’eddagala.
Yoruba: Àjọ Elétò-Ìlera Àgbááyé (WHO) dábàá kíka hóró CD4 kí á tó bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìtọ́jú lọ́wọ́ kòkòrò fáírọ́ọ̀sì (ART) láti ṣàwárí ààrun HIV tí ipò rẹ̀ ga, àti bíbẹ̀rẹ̀ àyẹ̀wò ipa ìwọ̀n kòkòrò fáírọ́ọ̀sì (VL) ART láti ṣàwárí ìkùnà ìtọ́jú.
Zulu: I-World Health Organization (WHO) incoma ukubala kwe-CD4 cell ngaphambi kokuqala ukwelashwa ngezidambisigciwane (ART) ukuze kutholwe isifo se-HIV esithuthukisiwe, kanye nokuhlolwa kwe-viral load (VL) okujwayelekile kulandela ukuqaliswa kwe-ART ukuze kutholwe ukwehluleka kokwelashwa.
Hausa: Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) ta bayar da shawarar ƙidaya sel na CD4 kafin a fara maganin rigakafin cutar HIV (ART) don gano cutar HIV da ta ci gaba, da gwajin yawan ƙwayar cuta na yau da kullum (VL) bayan ƙaddamarwar ART dominn gano gazawar jiyya.
Northern Sotho: Mokgatlo wa Maphelo wa Lefase (WHO) o šišinywa gore go dirwe palo ya disele tša CD4 pele ga ge go ka thongwa kalafo ka dianthiretherobaerale (ART) ka nepo ya go hetša bolwetši bja HIV bjo bo kekilego, le teko ya morwalo wa dibaerase (VL) ye e dirwago ka sewelo ka morago ga go fana ka ART go tseba ka ga go palelwa ga kalafo.
Amharic: የአለም ጤና ድርጅት (አ.ጤ.ድ) የጠና ኤችአይቪ በሽታን ቀድሞ ለማወቅ የጸረ ኤችአይቪ ህክምናን (ጸ.ኤ.ህ) ከመጀመሩ በፊት የሲዲ4 ሴል ቆጠራ እንዲካሄድ ይመክራል፤ እንዲሁም የጸ.ኤ.ህ ከተጀመረ በኋላ የህክምና መክሸፍን ለይቶ ለማወቅ መደበኛ የቫይረስ ሸክም (ቫ.ሸ) ምርመራ ይደረጋል።

English: Donor support for CD4 testing has declined to prioritize access to VL monitoring.
Luganda: Abagabi b’obuyambi bw’okukebera CD4 baagaana okukulembeza eky’okulondoola VL.
Yoruba: Àtìlẹyìn àwọn aṣètọrẹ fún CD4 ti kùnà láti mú níní àǹfààní sí ìbójútó VL ní pàtàkì.
Zulu: Usekelo lwabanikeli ekuhloleni i-CD4 lwenqabile ukubeka kuqala ukufinyelela ekuqaphelweni kwe-VL.
Hausa: Tallafin masu bayar da gudummawa don gwajin CD4 ya ragu wajen bayar da fifiko ga samun damar sa-ido na VL.
Northern Sotho: Thekgo ya bathekgi ba ditšhelete go teko ya CD4 e theogetše fase ka nepo ya go bea pele tlhokomelo ya VL.
Amharic: ለሲዲ4 ምርመራ የለጋሾች ድጋፍ የቫ.ሸ ክትትል ማግኘትን ቅድሚያ ለምስጠት እምቢ ብሏል።

English: We examined trends in CD4 and VL testing among adults (≥15 years of age) starting ART in Southern Africa.
Luganda: Twekenneenya ebibaawo mu kukebera CD4 ne VL mu bantu abakulu (emyaka ≥15) abatandika ART mu Afirika ey’Obukiikaddyo.
Yoruba: A ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò àwọn ìkáàkiri nínú CD4 àti àyẹ̀wò VL láàrin àwọn àgbà (≥ ọmọ ọdún 15) láti bẹ̀rẹ̀ ART ní ẹkùn Gúúsù ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Sihlole izitayela ekuhlolweni kwe-CD4 ne-VL kubantu abadala (≥iminyaka engu-15 ubudala) abaqala i-ART eNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Mun bincika abubuwan da suke faruwa a gwajin CD4 da kuma VL a tsakanin manya (‘yan shekaru ≥15) da suka fara ART a Kudancin Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Re ile ra lekola diphetogo ka go CD4 le teko ya VL gareng ga batho ba bagolo (ba go feta mengwaga ye ≥15) go thoma ka ART ka Borwa bja Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: ከደቡብ አፍሪካ ጸ.ኤ.ህ በመጀመር በአዋቂዎች (≥15 አመት እድሜ) በሲዲ4 እና በቫ.ሸ ምርመራ ላይ ያሉ አዝማሚያዎችን ፈትሸናል።

English: We analysed data from 14 HIV treatment programmes in Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe in 2005 to 2018.
Luganda: Twekenneenya obubaka okuva mu pulogulaamu 14 ez’okujjanjaba HIV mu Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, South Africa, Zambia ne Zimbabwe mu 2005 okutuuka mu 2018.
Yoruba: A ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ dátà ètò ìtọjú ààrun HIV 14 ní orílẹ̀-èdè Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, South Africa, Zambia àti Zimbabwe ní ọdún 2005 sí 2018.
Zulu: Sihlaziye idatha evela ezinhlelweni zokwelashwa kwe-HIV eziyi-14 eLesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, South Africa, Zambia naseZimbabwe ngo-2005 kuya ku-2018.
Hausa: Mun yi nazarin bayanai daga shirye-shiryen jiyya na cutar HIV guda 14 a Lesotho da Malawi da Mozambique da Afirka ta Kudu da Zambiya da kuma Zimbabwe a cikin shekarar 2005 zuwa shekarar 2018.
Northern Sotho: Re ile ra sekaseka tshedimošo go tšwa ka mananeong a 14 a kalafo ya HIV ka Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, South Africa, Zambia le ka Zimbabwe ka 2005 go fihla ka 2018.
Amharic: በሌሶቶ፣ በማላዊ፣ በሞዛምቢክ፣ በደቡብ አፍሪካ፣ በዛምቢያ እና በዚምባብዌ ከ2005 እስከ 2018 ከ14 የኤችአይቪ ህክምናዎች የተገኙ መረጃዎችን ተንትነናል።

English: We examined the frequency of CD4 and VL testing, the percentage of adults with CD4 or VL tests, and among those having a test, the percentage starting ART with advanced HIV disease (CD4 count <200 cells/mm3 ) or failing to suppress viral replication (>1000 HIV-RNA copies/mL) after ART initiation.
Luganda: Twekebejja emirundi gy’okukebera CD4 ne VL, omuwendo gw’abantu abakulu abakeberwa CD4 oba VL, era mu abo abakeberwa, omuwendo gw’abo abatandika ART nga balina HIV akuze (CD4 ow’obutaffaali <200 /mm3) oba abalemererwa okukendeeza okwekubisaamu kw’akawuka (>1000 HIV-RNA copies/mL) oluvannyuma lw’okutandika ART.
Yoruba: A wo iye ìyẹjọ àyẹ̀wò CD4 àti VL, ìwọ̀n àwọn àgbà tí ó ní CD4 tàbí àyẹ̀wò VL, àti láàáría àwọn tí wọ́n ní ìdánwò kan, ìdá nínú ìdá ọgọ́rùn náà bẹ̀rẹ̀ ART pẹ̀lú ààrun HIV tí ipò rẹ̀ ga (CD4 count <200 cells/mm3 ) tàbí kikùnà láti mú àdíkù bá ìsọdọ̀pọ̀ kòkòrò fáírọ́ọ̀sì (>1000 HIV-RNA copies/mL) lẹ́yìn ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ART.
Zulu: Sihlole imvamisa yokuhlolwa kwe-CD4 ne-VL, iphesenti labantu abadala abahlolelwa i-CD4 noma i-VL, futhi phakathi kwalabo abahlolwayo, iphesenti lokuqala imishanguzo yesifo sengculaza ngesifo se-HIV esithuthukisiwe (CD4 count <200 cells/mm3) noma abahluleka ukucindezela ukuphindaphindeka kwegciwane (>amakhophi angu-1000 e-HIV-RNA/mL) ngemva kokuqaliswa kwe-ART.
Hausa: Mun bincika yawan gwajin CD4 da kuma VL, adadin kashin manya masu CD4 ko gwaje-gwajen VL, kuma daga cikin waɗanda suke da gwajin, adadin fara ART ɗauke da cutar HIV mai ci gaba (ƙidayar CD4 <200 sel/mm3) ko kasawa don hana kwafin ƙwayar cuta (>1000 kwafin HIV-RNA/mL) bayan ƙaddamarwar ART.
Northern Sotho: Re ile ra lekola bokgafetšakgafetša ga CD4 le ga teko ya VL, persente ya batho ba bagolo bao ba nago le CD4 goba diteko tša VL, le magareng ga bao ba dirwa teko, persente ye e thomago kalafo ka ART ka bolwetši bja HIV bjo bo kekilego (palo ya CD4 <200 ya disele/mm3 ) goba go palelwa go gatelela go ikoketša ga dibaerase (>1000 HIV-RNA dikhopi/mL) ka morago ga go thomiša ka ART.
Amharic: የሲዲ4 እና የቫ.ሸ ምርመራ የሚደረጉበትን ፍጥነት፣ ሲዲ4 እና ቫ.ሸ ያለባቸውን አዋቂዎች ፐርሰንቴጅ እና ምርመራውን እያደረጉ ካሉ ሰዎች መካከል ጸ.ኤ.ህ ከጠና የኤችአይቪ በሽታ የሚጀምሩ ሰዎችን ፐርሰንቴጅ (ሲዲ4 ቁጥር <200ሴሎች/mm3 ) ከጸ.ኤ.ህ መጀመር በኋላ ቫይረስ አስመስሎ መስራትን (ሲዲ4 ቁጥር <200 ሴሎች/mm3 ) መግታት ያልቻሉትን ሰዎች ፈትሸናል፡፡

English: We used mixed effect logistic regression to assess time trends adjusted for age and sex.
Luganda: Twakozesa enkola ya mixed effect logistic regression okuzuula obudde obutuukanyiziddwa n’ekikula.
Yoruba: A lo ètò ìpadàṣẹ́yìn aládàpò ipa láti ní àǹfààní sí ìkáàkiri àkókò tí a ṣàtúnṣe fún ọjọ́ orí àti ẹ̀yà-ìbí.
Zulu: Sisebenzise ukuhlehla kwezinto ezinomphumela oxubile ukuze sihlole amathrendi esikhathi alungiselwe ubudala nobulili.
Hausa: Mun yi amfani da gaurayen sakamako koma bayan dabaru don tantance yanayin lokaci da aka daidaita don shekaru da kuma jinsi.
Northern Sotho: Re ile ra šomiša kgatelomorago ya kamaganyo ye e hlakantšwego ya seabe go lekola diphetogo tša dinako tšeo di beakanyeditšwego mengwaga le bong.
Amharic: በእድሜ እና በጾታ የተስተካከሉ የጊዜ አዝማሚያዎችን ለማሰስ የተቀላቀለ ተጽእኖ ሎጂስቲካዊ አማካይ ተዛምዶን ተጠቅመናል።

Luganda: Ebyavaamu

English: Among 502,456 adults, the percentage with CD4 testing at ART initiation decreased from a high of 78.1% in 2008 to a low of 38.0% in 2017; the probability declined by 14% each year (odds ratio (OR) 0.86; 95% CI 0.86 to 0.86).
Luganda: Mu bantu abakulu 502,456, omuwendo gw’abo abakeberwa CD4 nga batandika ART gwakendeera okuva ku gwa waggulu ogw’ebitundu 78.1% mu 2008 ku gwa wansi ogwa 38.0% mu 2017; omukisa gwakendeera n’ebitundu 14% buli mwaka (odds ratio (OR) 0.86; 95% CI 0.86 ku 0.86).
Yoruba: Láàrin àwọn àgbà 502,456, ìdá nínú ìdá ọgọ́rùn tí ó ní àyẹ̀wò CD4 ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ART dínkù láti òkè 78.1% ní ọdún 2008 wá sí ìsàlẹ̀ 38.0% ní ọdún 2017 ìṣeéṣe rẹ̀ ń kùnà pẹ̀lú 14% ní ọdún kọ̀ọ̀kan (ìpín àìdọ́gba (OR) 0.86; 95% CI 0.86 to 0.86).
Zulu: Kubantu abadala abayizi-502,456, iphesenti lokuhlolelwa i-CD4 ekuqaleni kwe-ART lehla lisuka kwaphezulu elingama-78.1% ngo-2008 laya ngaphansi kwama-38.0% ngo-2017; amathuba ehle ngo-14% unyaka ngamunye (isilinganiso sezinkinga (OR) 0.86; 95% CI 0.86 kuya ku-0.86).
Hausa: Daga cikin manya guda 502,456, adadin masu ɗauke da gwajin CD4 a ƙaddamarwar ART ya ragu daga babban kashi 78.1% a cikin shekarar 2008 zuwa ƙarancin 38.0% a cikin shekarar 2017; yiwuwar ta ƙi ta kashi14% a kowace shekara (rabo mara kyau (OR) 0.86; 95% CI 0.86 zuwa 0.86).
Northern Sotho: Gareng ga batho ba bagolo ba 502,456, persente ya bao ba dirwa teko ya CD4 ge go thomilwe ka kalafo ya ART e ile ya fokotšega go tloga godimo ka 78.1% ka 2008 go ya fase ka 38.0% ka 2017; kgonagalo e ile ya theogela fase ka 14% ngwaga o mongwe le o mongwe (dikelo tša go se lekanele (OR) 0.86; 95% CI 0.86 go fihla go 0.86).
Amharic: ከ502456 አዋቂዎች መካከል በጸ.ኤ.ህ መጀመር ጊዜ የሲዲ4 ምርመራ ፐርሰንቴጅ በ2008 ከ78.1% ከፍታ በ2017 ወደ 38.0% ዝቅታ ቀንሷል፤ ይሆንታውም በየአመቱ በ14% ቀንሷል (የእድል መጠን (OR) 0.86፤ 95% አCI 0.86 እስከ 0.86)።

English: Frequency of CD4 testing also declined.
Luganda: Emirundi gy’okukebera CD4 nagyo gyakendeera.
Yoruba: Iye ìjẹyọ àyẹ̀wò CD4 náà kùnà.
Zulu: Imvamisa yokuhlolwa kwe-CD4 nayo yehlile.
Hausa: Haka nan yawan gwajin CD4 ya ragu.
Northern Sotho: Bokgafetšakgafetša ga teko ya CD4 le bjona bo ile bja theogela fase.
Amharic: የሲዲ4 ምርመራ የሚደረግበት ፍጥነትም ቀንሷል።

English: The percentage starting ART with advanced HIV disease declined from 83.3% in 2005 to 23.5% in 2018; each year the probability declined by 20% (OR 0.80; 95% CI 0.80 to 0.81).
Luganda: Omuwendo gw’abo abatandika ART nga balina obulwadde bwa HIV obukuze gwakendeera okuva ku 83.3% mu 2005 okutuuka ku 23.5% mu 2018; buli mwaka omukisa gwakendeera ebitundu 20% (OR 0.80; 95% CI 0.80 okutuuka ku 0.81).
Yoruba: Ìdá nínú ìdá ọgọ́rùn bíbẹ̀rẹ̀ ART pẹ̀lú ààrun HIV tí ipò rẹ̀ ga kùnà láti 83.3% ní ọdún 2005 sí 23.5% ní ọdún 2018; ní ọdọọdún ìṣeéṣe rẹ̀ máa ń kùnà láti 20% (OR 0.80; 95% CI 0.80 to 0.81).
Zulu: Iphesenti eliqala imishanguzo yesifo sengculaza ngesifo sengculazi esithuthukile lehla lisuka ku-83.3% ngo-2005 laya ku-23.5% ngowezi-2018; unyaka ngamunye amathuba ehla ngo-20% (OR 0.80; 95% CI 0.80 kuya ku-0.81).
Hausa: Adadin fara ART ɗauke da cutar HIV mai ci gaba ya ragu daga kashi 83.3% a cikin shekarar 2005 zuwa 23.5% a cikin shekarar 2018; a kowace shekara yiwuwar ta ragu da kashi 20% (OR 0.80; 95% CI 0.80 zuwa 0.81).
Northern Sotho: Persente ya bao ba thomilego ka kalafo ya ART ka bolwetši bja HIV bjo bo kekilego go tloga go 83.3% ka 2005 go fihla go 23.5% ka 2018; ngwaga o mongwe le o mongwe kgonagalo e ile ya theogela fase ka 20% (OR 0.80; 95% CI 0.80 go fihla go 0.81).
Amharic: ከጠና የኤችአይቪ በሽታ ጸ.ኤ.ህ የሚጀምርበት ፐርስነቴጅ በ2005 ከ83.3% በ2018 ወደ 23.5% ቀንሶ ነበር። በየአመቱ ይሆንታው በ20% ቀንሷል (OR 0.80፤ 95% CI 0.80 ወደ 0.81)።

English: VL testing after starting ART varied; 61.0% of adults in South Africa and 10.7% in Malawi were tested, but fewer than 2% were tested in the other four countries.
Luganda: Okukebera VL oluvannyuma lw’okutandika ART kwali kukyukakyuka; ebitundu 61.0% eby’abantu abakulu mu South Afirika ne 10.7% mu Malawi baakeberwa, naye abatawera bitundu 2% be baakeberwa mu mawanga amalala ana.
Yoruba: Àyẹ̀wò VL lẹ́yìn ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ART máa ń yàtọ̀; 61.0% àwọn àgbà ní orílẹ̀-èdè South Africa àti 10.7% ní orílẹ̀-èdè Malawi jẹ́ yíyẹ̀wò, ṣùgbọ́n ìwọ̀n tó kéré sí 2% ni a yẹ̀wọ̀ ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè mẹ́rin yòókù.
Zulu: Ukuhlolwa kwe-VL ngemva kokuqala i-ART kwahlukahluka; U-61.0% wabantu abadala eNingizimu Afrika no-10.7% eMalawi bahlolwa, kodwa bangaphansi kuka-2% abahloliwe kwamanye amazwe amane.
Hausa: Gwajin VL bayan fara ART ya bambanta; an gwada kashi 61.0% na manya a Afirka ta Kudu da kashi 10.7% a Malawi, amma an gwada ƙasa da kashi 2% a sauran ƙasashe huɗu.
Northern Sotho: Telo ya VL ka morago ga go thomiša ka kalafo ya ART e ile ya fapana; 61.0% ya batho ba bagolo ka Afrika Borwa le 10.7% ka Malawi ba ile ba dirwa diteko, eupša ba ka fase ga ba 2% ba ile ba dirwa diteko ka dinageng tše dingwe tše nne.
Amharic: ጸ.ኤ.ህ ከተጀመረ በኋላ የቫ.ሸ ምርመራ ይለያይ ነበር፤ በደቡብ አፍሪካ 61.0% አዋቂዎች እና በማላዊ 10.7% ተፈትሸው ነበር፤ ነገር ግን በሌሎቹ አራት ሃገራት የተመረመሩት ከ2% ያነሱ ሰዎች ብቻ ነበሩ ።

English: The probability of VL testing after ART start increased only modestly each year (OR 1.06; 95% CI 1.05 to 1.06).
Luganda: Omkisa gw’okukeberwa VL oluvannyuma lw’okutandika ART gweyongerako katono buli mwaka (OR 1.06; 95% CI 1.05 ku 1.06).
Yoruba: Ìṣeéṣe àyẹ̀wò VL lẹ́yìn ART bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní lé síi díẹ̀díẹ̀ lọ́dún kọ̀ọ̀kan (OR 1.06; 95% CI 1.05 to 1.06).
Zulu: Amathuba okuhlolwa kwe-VL ngemva kokuqala kwe-ART anda ngesizotha kuphela unyaka ngamunye (OR 1.06; 95% CI 1.05 kuya ku-1.06).
Hausa: Yiwuwar gwajin VL bayan fara ART ya ƙaru kawai a hankali a kowace shekara (OR 1.06; 95% CI 1.05 zuwa 1.06).
Northern Sotho: Kgonagalo ya teko ya VL ka morago ga kalafo ka ART e ile ya oketšega fela gannyane ngwaga o mongwe le o mongwe (OR 1.06; 95% CI 1.05 go fihla go 1.06).
Amharic: የጸ.ኤ.ህ ከተጀመረ በኋላ የቫ.ሸ ምርመራ የማድረግ ይሆንታ በመጠኑ ጨምሯል (OR 1.06፤ 95% አCI 1.05 ወደ 1.06)።

English: The percentage with unsuppressed VL was 8.6%.
Luganda: Omuwendo gw’abo abalina VL etakendeezeddwa gwali ebitundu 8.6%.
Yoruba: Ìdá nínú ìdá ọgọ́rùn pẹ̀lú VL tí àdínkù kò bá jẹ́ 8.6%.
Zulu: Iphesenti eline-VL engacindezelwanga lalingu-8.6%.
Hausa: Kason VL da ba a danne shi ba ya kasance kashi 8.6%.
Northern Sotho: Persente ya bao ba nago le morwalo wa baerase (VL) wo o gateletšwego e bile 8.6%.
Amharic: ያልታፈነ የቫ.ሸ ፐርሰንቴጅ 8.6% ነበር።

English: There was no evidence of a decrease in unsuppressed VL over time (OR 1.00; 95% CI 0.99 to 1.01).
Luganda: Tewaaliwo bukakafu bwa kukendeera kw’abo abalina VL etakendeezeddwa oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera (OR 1.00; 95% CI 0.99 ku 1.01).
Yoruba: Kò sí àpẹẹrẹ ìdínkù nínú VL tí a kò mú àdíkù lẹ́yìn ìgbà náà (OR 1.00; 95% CI 0.99 to 1.01).
Zulu: Kwakungekho bufakazi bokuncipha kwe-VL engacindezelwe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi (OR 1.00; 95% CI 0.99 kuya ku-1.01).
Hausa: Babu wata shaida ta raguwa a cikin VL da ba a danne ba a tsawon lokaci (OR 1.00; 95% CI 0.99 zuwa 1.01).
Northern Sotho: Ga se gwa ba le bohlatse bja go fokotšega ka go VL ye e sego ya gatelelwa mo nakong ye itšego (OR 1.00; 95% CI 0.99 go fihla go 1.01).
Amharic: በጊዜ ብዛት ያልታፈነ የቫ.ሸ መቀነስ ስለመኖሩ ምንም አይነት ማስረጃ አልነበረም (OR 1.00፤ 95% አCI 0.99 እስከ 1.01)።

English: Conclusions
Luganda: Okukubira
Yoruba: Ìkádìí
Zulu: Isiphetho
Hausa: Kammalawa
Northern Sotho: Mafetšo
Amharic: መደምደሚያ

English: CD4 cell counting declined over time, including testing at the start of ART, despite the fact that many patients still initiated ART with advanced HIV disease.
Luganda: Okubala CD4 kwakendeera oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera, omuli n’okukebera ku ntandikwa ya ART, newankubadde ng’abalwadde bangi baali bakyatandika ART nga balina HIV akuze.
Yoruba: ̣Hóró CD4 kíkà máa ń kùnà tó bá yá, tí ó fi mọ́ àyẹ̀wò ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ART, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé púpọ̀ nínú àwọn aláìsàn ṣì ń bẹ̀rẹ̀ ART pẹ̀lú ààrun HIV tí ipò rẹ̀ ga.
Zulu: Ukubalwa kwamaseli e-CD4 kwehla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, okuhlanganisa nokuhlolwa ekuqaleni kwe-ART, naphezu kweqiniso lokuthi iziguli eziningi zisaqala imishanguzo yegciwane lengculaza ngesifo se-HIV esithuthukisiwe.
Hausa: Ƙididdigar sel na CD4 ta ragu a tsawon lokaci, ciki har da gwaji a farkon ART, duk da cewa yawancin marasa lafiya sun fara ART tare da cutar HIV mai ci gaba.
Northern Sotho: Palo ya disele ya CD4 e ile ya fokotšega ge nakong ye itšego, go akaretšwa teko mathomong a ART, ka ntle le taba ya gore balwetši ba bantši ba sa thomišitve ka ART ka bolwetši bjo bo kekilego bja HIV.
Amharic: ምንም እንኳ ብዙ በሽተኞች የጸ.ኤ.ህ የጀመሩት ከጠና የኤችአይቪ በሽታ ቢሆንም የሲዲ4 ሴል ቆጠራ በጊዜ ብዛት የቀነሰ ሲሆን ይህም በጸ.ኤ.ህ ጅማሪ ላይ የተደረገ ምርመራን ያካትታል።

English: Without CD4 testing and expanded VL testing many patients with advanced HIV disease and treatment failure may go undetected, threatening the effectiveness of ART in sub-Saharan Africa.
Luganda: Awatali kukebera CD4 n’okukebera VL abalwadde bangi abalina HIV akuze n’okulemwa kw’eddagala biyinza obutazuulwa, ekiyinza okulemesa ART okukola obulungi mu Afirika eya wansi w’eddungu Sahara.
Yoruba: Láìsí àyẹ̀wò CD4 àti àyẹ̀wò VL tí a fẹ̀ lójú, púpọ̀ àwọn aláìsàn pẹ̀lú ààrun HIV tí ipò rẹ̀ ga àti ìkùnà ìtọ́jú lè má di ṣíṣàwárí, kí ó sì má halẹ̀ mọ́ ìṣiṣẹ́ ART ní ìhà ìsàlẹ̀-Aṣálẹ̀ Sàhárà Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Ngaphandle kokuhlolwa kwe-CD4 nokuhlolwa kwe-VL okwandisiwe iziguli eziningi ezinesifo se-HIV esithuthukisiwe kanye nokwehluleka kokwelashwa kungase kungabonakali, okusongela ukuphumelela kwe-ART e-sub-Saharan Africa.
Hausa: Ba tare da gwajin CD4 da gwajin VL da aka faɗaɗa ba, marasa lafiya da suke fama da cutar HIV mai ci gaba da gazawar jiyya suna iya zuwa ba a gano su ba, suna barazanar tasirin ART a yankin Afirka Kudu da Sahara.
Northern Sotho: Ka ntle le teko ya CD4 le teko ya VL ye e gatetvego pele balwetši ba bantši bao ba nago le bolwetši bjo bo kekilego bja HIV le go palelwa ga dihlare ba ka no se tsebje, gomme se se tla tšhošetša go šoma gabotse ga ART ka Borwa bja Afrika.
Amharic: ያለ ሲዲ4 እና የተስፋፋ የቫ.ሸ ምርመራ የጠና የኤችአይቪ በሽታ ታማሚዎች እና ህክምና የከሸባቸው ብዙ በሽተኞች ሳይታወቅ ሊቀሩ ይችላሉ፣ ይህም ከሳህራ በታች አፍሪካ የጸ.ኤ.ህ ውጤታማነትን አደጋ ላይ ሊጥል ይችላል።

English: The effectiveness of anti-HIV treatment in southern Africa is at risk, said researchers, because inconsistent or declined HIV testing might miss patients who suffer with advanced disease or those for whom treatment is not working.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti enkola y’eddagala lya HIV mu Afirika ey’Obukiikaddyo eri mu katyabaga, kubanga okukebera HIV okutakwatagana oba okukendedde kuyinza kuyinza obutatuuka ku balwadde abalina HIV akuze oba abo eddagala be litakolako.
Yoruba: Ìṣiṣẹ́ ìtọ́jú agbógunti-ààrun HIV ní ìhà gúúsù Áfíríkà ń kojú ewu, ni àwọn aṣèwádìí wí, nítorí pé àìṣedéédé tàbí ìkùnà àyẹ̀wò ààrun HIV lè pàdánù àwọn aláìsàn tí wọn ń bá ààrun tí ipò rẹ̀ ga fínra àbí àwọn tí ìtọ́jú wọn kò ṣiṣẹ́.
Zulu: Ukuphumelela kokwelashwa kwe-HIV eningizimu ye-Afrika kusengozini, kusho abacwaningi, ngoba ukuhlolelwa i-HIV okungaguquki noma okwenqatshwa kungase kuphuthelwe yiziguli ezinesifo esithuthuke kakhulu noma lezo ezingasebenzi ukwelashwa kwazo.
Hausa: A cewar masu binciken, amfanin maganin cutar HIV a kudancin Afirka yana cikin haɗari, saboda rashin daidaituwa ko raguwar gwajin cutar HIV yana iya rasa marasa lafiya da suke fama da cututtukan da suka ci gaba ko kuma waɗanda ba ya aiki don jiyyarsu.
Northern Sotho: Seabe sa kalafo ya go lwantšha HIV ka Borwa bja Afrika se kotsing, gwa bolela banyakišiši, ka gobane go dira diteko tša HIV ka fao go sa swanego goba go theogela fase go ka hlaelela balwetši bao ba nago le bolwetši bjo bo keilego goba bao kalafo e sa šomego gona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳሉት በደቡብ አፍሪካ የጸረ ኤችአይቪ ህክምና አደጋ ላይ ነው የዚህም ምክንያት የቀነሰ ወይም መደበኛ ያልሆነ የኤችአይቪ ምርመራ የጠና በሽታ ያለባቸውን ወይም ህክምና እየሰራላቸው ያልሆኑ በሽተኞችን ሳያካትት ሊቀር ስለሚችል ነው።

English: A person’s HIV status is commonly checked using a test called a “CD4 cell count”, which measures the number of immune cells (called CD4 cells) that are actively fighting the infection.
Luganda: Embeera y’omuntu eya HIV etera okukeberwa nga bakozesa enkola eyitibwa“CD4 cell count”, ng’eno epima omuwendo gw’obutaffaali bw’obusibage (obuyitibwa CD4 cells) obulwanyise obulwadde.
Yoruba: Ipò ààrun HIV èèyàn máa ń sábà di yíyẹ̀wò pẹ̀lú àyẹ̀wò kan tí à ń pè ní “ìka hóró CD4” tí ó ń ka iye àwọn hóró adèènà (tí à ń pè ní hóró CD4) tí ó ń gbógun ti ìkọlù.
Zulu: Isimo somuntu se-HIV ngokuvamile sibhekwa kusetshenziswa ukuhlolwa. ebizwa ngokuthi “isibalo se-CD4 cell”, esikala inani lamaseli omzimba (abizwa ngokuthi ama-CD4 cell) alwa naleli gciwane.
Hausa: Ana yawan duba matsayin mutum na HIV ta amfani da gwajin da ake kira “ƙididdigar sel na CD4”, wanda yake auna adadin ƙwayoyin garkuwar jiki (wanda ake kira sel na CD4) waɗanda suke yaƙar kamuwa da cuta.
Northern Sotho: Maemo a motho a HIV ka tlwaelo a a lekolwa ka go šomiša teko ye e bitšwago “palo ya disele ya CD”, yeo e elago palo ya disele tša mašole a mmele (tše di bitšwago disele tša CD4) tšeo di šomago ka mafolofolo go lwantšha phetetšo.
Amharic: የአንድ ሰው የኤችአይቪ ሁኔታ በመደበኛነት “የሲዲ4 የሴል ቆጠራ” የተሰኘ ምርመራን በማድረግ ይፈተሻል፤ ይህም በንቃት ኢንፌክሽኑን የሚዋጉትን የበሽታ ተከላካይ ሴሎች ቁጥር (ሲዲ4 የተሰኙትን) ይመዝናል።

English: Doctors can also check a patient’s viral load (VL), which is the number of HIV particles in their body, if they want to know how well treatment is working to suppress the virus.
Luganda: Abasawo era basobola okukebera VL y’omulwadde, nga guno gwe muwendo gw’obuwuka bwa HIV mu mubiri gwe, bwe baba nga baagala okumanya enkola y’eddagala mu kukendeeza akawuka.
Yoruba: Àwọn dókítà bákan náà lè ṣe àyẹ̀wò ìwọn kòkòrò fáírọ́ọ̀sì inú ẹ̀jẹ̀ (VL) ínú ara aláìsàn, léyìí tííṣe ìwọn kòkòrò ààrùn HIV nínú ara wọn, tí wọ́n bá fẹ́ mọ bí ìtọ́jú ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́ sí láti mú àdínkù bá kòkòrò fáírọ́ọ̀sì náà.
Zulu: Odokotela bangakwazi futhi ukuhlola umthamo wegciwane egazini wesiguli (VL), okuyinani lezinhlayiya ze-HIV emzimbeni waso, uma befuna ukwazi ukuthi kusebenza kahle kangakanani ukwelashwa ukucindezela igciwane.
Hausa: Haka nan likitoci kuma za su iya duba yawan ƙwayar cuta (VL), wanda wato shi ne adadin ƙwayoyin cutar HIV a jikinsu, idan suna son sanin yadda maganin yake aiki wajen daƙile ƙwayar cutar.
Northern Sotho: Dikgaka di ka lekola gape morwalo wa dibaerase (VL) wa molwetši, e lego palo ya ditsekana tša HIV ka mmeleng wa bona, ge e le gore ba nyaka go tseba gore kalafo e šoma gabotse bjang go gatelela baerase.
Amharic: ቫይረሱን ለማጥፋት ህክምና እንዴት በጥሩ ሁኔታ እየሰራ እንዳለ ለማወቅ ከፈለጉ በተጨማሪ ዶክተሮች የበሽተኛን የቫይረስ ሸክም (ቫ.ሸ) ሊፈትሹ ይችላሉ፤ ይህም በበሽተኞቹ ሰውነት ውስጥ ያሉ የኤችአይቪ ቅንጣቶች ቁጥር ነው።

English: The World Health Organisation (WHO) recommends a CD4 cell count before a patient starts antiretroviral therapy (ART) to determine if a person has advanced HIV disease, and they suggest routinely checking viral load once treatment has started to make sure it is working.
Luganda: Ekitongole ky’Ebyobulamu mu Nsi Yonna (WHO) kisemba okubala obutaffaali bwa CD4 ng’omulwadde tannatandika ddagala likkakkanya ku Mukenenya (ART) okuzuula oba ng’omuntu alina HIV akuze, era basemba eky’okukeberanga omuwendo gw’akawuka ng’obujjanjabi butandise okukakasa nti Bukola.
Yoruba: Àjọ Elétò-Ìlera Àgbááyé (WHO) dábàá kíka hóró CD4 kí ó tó di pé aláìsàn kan bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìtọ́jú lọ́wọ́ kòkòrò fáírọ́ọ̀sì (ART) láti mọ bóyá ènìyàn kan ní ààrun HIV tí ipò rẹ̀ ga, wọ́n sì dábàá yíyẹ ìwọn kòkòrò fáírọ́ọ̀sì inú ẹ̀jẹ̀ wò lọ́gán tí ìtọ́jú bá ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ láti ríi dájú pé ó ń ṣiṣẹ́.
Zulu: Inhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba wonke (WHO) incoma isibalo samaseli e-CD4 ngaphambi kokuba isiguli siqale ukwelashwa ngezidambisigciwane (ART) ukuze kutholwe ukuthi umuntu unesifo se-HIV esithuthukisiwe yini, futhi baphakamisa ukuhlola umthamo wegciwane egazini njalo uma ukwelashwa sekuqalile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyasebenza.
Hausa: Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) ta bayar da shawarar a ƙirga sel na CD4 kafin majiyyaci ya fara maganin cutar ƙanjamau (ART) don tantance ko mutum ya kamu da cutar HIV mai ci gaba, kuma sun bayar da shawarar a riƙa duba yawan ƙwayar cutar da zarar an fara jiyya don tabbatar da cewa yana aiki.
Northern Sotho: Mokgatlo wa Maphelo wa Lefase (WHO) o šišinywa gore go dirwe palo ya disele ya CD4 pele ga ge molwetši a ka thomiša go nwa dihlare tša dianthiretherobaerale (ART) go tseba ge eba motho o na le bolwetši bja HIV bjo bo kekilego, ebile ba akanya gore go dirwe tekolo ya sewelo yeo ba lekolago morwalo wa dibaerase ge kalafo e thomilwe go netefatša gore e a šoma.
Amharic: የአለም የጤና ድርጅት (አ.ጤ.ድ) አንድ ታማሚ የጠና የኤችአይቪ በሽታ እንዳለበት ለማወቅ እና አንዴ ህክምና ከተጀመረ በኋላ በትክክሉ እንደሚሰራ ለማረጋገጥ የቫይረስ ሸክምን በመደበኛነት መፈተሽ እንደሚያስፈልግ ይመክራል፤ በተጨማሪ የጸረ ኤችአይቪ ህክምና ከመጀመሩ በፊት (ጸ.ኤ.ህ) የሲዲ4 ሴል ቆጠራ እንዲደረግም ይጠቁማል።

English: In this study, researchers wanted to find out how CD4 cell counts and viral load testing is being used to monitor HIV status and treatment success in patients in southern Africa.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okuzuula engeri okubala omuwendo gw’obutaffaali bwa CD4 n’okukebera obungi bw’akawuka gye bikozesebwamu okulondoola embeera ya HIV n’enkola y’obujjanjabi mu balwadde mu bukiikaddyo bwa Afirika.
Yoruba: Ní inú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn ạṣèwádìí fẹ́ wádìí bí iye hóró CD4 àti àyẹ̀wò ìwọn kòkòrò fáírọ́ọ̀sì inú ẹ̀jẹ̀ ń di lílò láti fi ṣàmójútó ipò aàrùn HIV àti àṣeyọrí ìtọ́jú lára àwọn aláìsàn ní ìhà gúúsù ilẹ̀ Áfífíkà.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuthola ukuthi i-CD4 cell count futhi ukuhlolwa kwenani legciwane egazini kusetshenziswa ukuqapha isimo se-HIV kanye nempumelelo yokwelashwa ezigulini eziseningizimu ye-Afrika.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu bincikens sun so gano yadda aƙe amfani da sel na CD4 da kuma yawan ƙwayar cuta wajen sa-ido a kan matsayin cutar HIV da kuma samun nasarar jiyya ga marasa lafiya a kudancin Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go tseba ka fao palo ya disele ya CD4 le teko ya morwalo wa baerase e šomišwago ka gona go lekola maemo a HIV le katlego ya kalafo go balwetši ka Borwa bja Afrika.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት በደቡብ አፍሪካ የሲዲ4 ሴሎች ቆጠራ እና የቫይረስ ሸክም ምርመራ የኤችአይቪ ሁኔታን እና የበሽተኞችን የህክምና ስኬት ለማረጋገጥ እንዴት ጥቅም ላይ እየዋለ እንደሆነ ማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር።

English: They analysed data from more than 500 000 patients in HIV treatment programmes within Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe, during the years 2005 to 2018.
Luganda: Beekenneenya obubaka okuva mu balwadde abasukka 500 000 mu pulogulaamu z’okujjanjaba HIV mu Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, South Afirika, Zambia ne Zimbabwe, mu myaka 2005 okutuuka 2018.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ àwọn dátà láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn aláìsàn 500 000 nínú àwọn ètò ìtọ́jú aàrùn HIV láàrin orílẹ̀-èdè Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe, láàrin ọdún 2005 sí 2018.
Zulu: Bahlaziye idatha yeziguli ezingaphezu kuka-500 000 ezinhlelweni zokwelashwa kwe-HIV phakathi kweLesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, South Africa, Zambia naseZimbabwe, phakathi neminyaka.2005 kuya ku-2018.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi nazarin bayanai daga sama da marasa lafiya guda 500 000 a cikin shirye-shiryen maganin cutar HIV a cikin Lesotho da Malawi da Mozambique da Afirka ta Kudu da Zambiya da kuma Zimbabwe, a cikin shekarun 2005 zuwa 2018.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba sekaseka Tshedimošo go balwetši ba go feta ba 500 000 ka maaneong a kalafo ya HIV ka Lesotho Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, Afrika Borwa, Zambia le Zimbabwe, ka mengwageng ya bo 2005 go fihla ka 2018.
Amharic: በሌሴቶ፣ በማላዊ፣ በሞዛምቢክ፣ በደቡብ አፍሪካ፣ በዛምቢያ እና በዚምቧብዌ ከ2005 እስከ 2018 በኤችአይቪ ህክምና ፕሮግራሞች ውስጥ ያሉ የ500000 በሽተኞችን መረጃ ተንትነው ነበር።

English: Their key finding was that CD4 cell count testing declined over time, and viral load testing trends to monitor treatment success were inconsistent.
Luganda: Ekikulu kye baazuula kyali nti okukebera obutaffaali bwa CD4 kwakendeera nga wayiseewo ekiseera, n’okukebera omuwendo gw’akawuka olw’okulondoola enkola y’obujjanjabi kwali kukyukakyuka.
Yoruba: Kókó ìwádìí wọn ni pé àyẹ̀wò iye hóró CD4 máa ń kùnà tó bá yá, ìkáàkiri àyẹ̀wò ìwọn kòkòrò fáírọ́ọ̀sì inú ẹ̀jẹ̀ sí àṣeyọrí bíbójútó ìtọ́jú kò ṣe déédé.
Zulu: Ukuthola kwabo okubalulekile kwaba ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwe-CD4 cell count yehla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, futhi izindlela zokuhlola umthamo wegciwane egazini ukuze kuqashwe impumelelo yokwelashwa zazingahambisani.
Hausa: Mahimmin abin da bincikensu ya gano sh ine cewa gwajin ƙididdigewa na sel na CD4 ya ragu a yau da kullum, kuma babu daidaito a yanayin gwajin yawan ƙwayar cuta domin sa-ido da kuma nasarar jiyya.
Northern Sotho: Kutollo ya bona ye bohlokwa e bile gore teko ya palo ya disele ya CD4 e ile ya theogela fase ge nako e dutše e, le diphetogo tša teko ya morwalo wa dibaerase go lekola katlego ya kalafo di be di sa swane.
Amharic: ዋና ግኝታቸው የሲዲ4 የሴል ቆጠራ ምርመራ በጊዜ ብዛት እንደቀነሰ ነው፤ እንዲሁም የህክምና ውጤታማነትን ለመከታተል የቫይረስ ሸክም ሙከራ አዝማሚያዎች መደበኛ አልነበሩም።

English: As mentioned above, CD4 cell counts are important to detect advanced HIV disease before starting treatment, but researchers said this testing declined despite the fact that many patients did initiate treatment with advanced HIV disease.
Luganda: Nga bwe kyalagiddwa waggulu, okubala CD4 kya mugaso mu kuzuula HIV akuze ng’obujjanjabi tebunnatandikibwa, naye abanoonyereza baagamba nti okukebera kuno kwakendeera newankubadde ng’abalwadde bangi baatandika obujjanjabi ng’obulwadde bwa HIV bukuze.
Yoruba: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí a ṣe sọ lókè, iye hóró CD4 ṣe pàtàkì láti ṣàwárí ààrun HIV tí ipò rẹ̀ ga kí wọ́n tó bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìtọ́jú, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé àyẹ̀wò náà máa ń kùnà bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé púpọ̀ àwọn aláìsàn ààrun HIV tí ipò rẹ̀ ga pẹ̀lú bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìtọ́jú.
Zulu: Njengoba kushiwo ngenhla, izibalo zamaseli e-CD4 zibalulekile ukuze kutholwe isifo se-HIV esithuthukisiwe ngaphambi kokuqala ukwelashwa, kodwa abacwaningi bathi lokhu kuhlolwa kwehlile naphezu kokuthi iziguli eziningi ziye zaqala ukwelashwa nge-HIV esezingeni eliphezulu.
Hausa: Kamar yadda aka ambata a sama, ƙididdigar sel na CD4 suna da mahimmanci don gano cutar HIV mai ci gaba kafin fara magani, amma masu binciken sun ce wannan gwajin ya ragu duk da cewa yawancin marasa lafiya sun fara maganin cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge go boletšwe ka mo godimo, dipalo tša disele tša CD4 di bohlokwa go hwetša bolwetši bja HIV bjo bo gatetvego pele pele ga ge go ka thomišwa ka kalafo, eupša banyakišiši ba boletše gore go dira diteko go theogetše fase ka ntle le gore balwetši ba bantši ba ile ba thomiša ka kalafo ya bolwetši bja HIV bjo bo kekilego.
Amharic: ከላይ እንደተገለጸው፣ ህክምናን ከመጀመራችን በፊት የጠና የኤችአይቪ በሽታን ለይቶ ለማወቅ የሲዲ4 የሴል ቁጥር አስፈላጊ ነው። ነገር ግን ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳሉት ብዙ የጠና የኤችአይቪ በሽታ ያለባቸው ታማሚዎች ህክምናን ቢጀምሩም ይህ ምርመራ ቀንሷል።

English: The findings from this study showed that the countries had drastically reduced their CD4 counts, but this is a problem because CD4 testing is important in finding out the stages of HIV and should still be used before the patients start their therapy.
Luganda: Ebyazuulwa mu kunoonyereza kuno byalaga nti amawanga gano gaali gakendedde nnyo kukebera CD4, naye nga kino kizibu kubanga okukebera CD4 kikulu mu kuzuula emitendera gya HIV era nga kulina okukozesebwa ng’abalwadde tebannatandika ddagala lyabwe.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà fi hàn pé àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè náà ti mú àdínkù ńlá bá iye CD4, ṣùgbọ́n ìṣòro ni èyí jẹ́ ní́torí pé àyẹ̀wò CD4 ṣe pàtàkì nínú wíwá ipò ààrùn HIV, ó sì gbọdọ̀ di lilò síbẹ̀ kí ó tó di pé àwọn aláìsàn bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìtọ́jú.
Zulu: Okutholwe kulolu cwaningo kukhombise ukuthi amazwe asehlise kakhulu i-CD4 count yawo, kodwa lokhu kuyinkinga ngoba ukuhlolwa kwe-CD4 kubalulekile ekutholeni izigaba ze-HIV futhi kusafanele kusetshenziswe ngaphambi kokuba iziguli ziqale ukwelashwa kwazo.
Hausa: Sakamakon wannan binciken ya nuna cewa ƙasashen sun rage adadin ƙididdigewar CD4 ɗinsu sosai, amma wannan matsala ce saboda gwajin CD4 yana da muhimmanci wajen gano matakan cutar HIV kuma har yanzu ya kamata a yi amfani da shi kafin majinyata su fara maganinsu.
Northern Sotho: Dikutollo go tšwa ka dinyakišišong tše di laeditše gore dinaga di fokoditše dipalo tša tšona tša CD4 kudu, eupša se ke bothata ka gobane teko ya CD4 e bohlokwa go tseba dikgato tša HIV gomme di swanetše go tšwela pele go šomišwa pele ga ge balwetši ba ka thomiša ka kalafo ya bona.
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናት ግኝቶች እንዳሳዩት ሃገሮቹ የሲዲ4 ቁጥሮቻቸውን በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ቀንሰው ነበር፣ ነገር ግን ይህ ችግር ነው ምክንያቱም የሲዲ4 ህክምና የኤችአይቪ ደረጃዎችን ለማወቅ አስፈላጊ ነው፤ እናም ታማሚዎቹ ህክምናቸውን ከመጀመራቸው በፊት ጥቅም ላይ መዋል አለበት።

English: Researchers caution however that their study has several limitations.
Luganda: Wabula abanoonyereza balabula nti okunoonyereza kwabwe kulina obuzibu bungi.
Yoruba: Àwọn Aṣèwádìí ṣèkìlò bákan náà pé iṣẹ́ ìwádìí wọn ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ akùdé.
Zulu: Nokho, abacwaningi bayaxwayisa ukuthi ukutadisha kunemikhawulo eminingana.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi gargaɗin cewa nazarinsu yana da iyakoki da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale banyakišiši ba lemoša gore dinyakišišo tša bona di na le mellwane ye mmalwa.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ተመራማሪዎቹ ጥናታቸው ብዙ ገደቦች እንዳሉበት ያስጠነቅቃሉ።

English: For instance, the patient data they used did not represent different regions as a whole.
Luganda: Okugeza, ebikwata ku balwadde bye baakozesa byali tebikiikirira bitundu eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, dátà aláìsàn tí wọ́n lò kò dúró fún oríṣìí àwọn ẹkùn lápapọ̀.
Zulu: Isibonelo, idatha yesiguli abayisebenzisile ayizange imele izifunda ezihlukene zizonke.
Hausa: Alal misali, bayanan marasa lafiya da suka yi amfani da su ba su wakilci yankuna daban-daban gabaɗaya ba.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, tshedimošo ya bona ya maabpi le balwetši yeo ba e šomišitšego ga se ya emela dilete tše di fapanego ka botlalo.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ የተጠቀሙት የበሽተኞች መረጃ በጥቅሉ ብዙ ክልሎችን አይወክልም ነበር።

English: Also, differences in lab testing could have skewed results, and they couldn’t account for missing patients who had stopped or changed treatment, or died.
Luganda: Era, enjawulo mu kukebera kw’omu magezeserezo kuyinza okuba nga kwaleetawo kyekubiira mu byazuulibwa, era tebaasobola kunnyonnyola ku balwadde abaabulawo nga bayimirizza oba bakyusizza eddagala, oba nga bafudde.
Yoruba: Bákan náà, ìyàtọ̀ nínú àyẹ̀wò láàbù lè ní àwọn èsì ẹ̀tàn, wọn ò sì lè dáhùn fún àwọn aláìsàn tí wọn ti yọ sọnù, tí wọ́n ti dá ìtọ́jú dúró àbí yí ìtọ́jú padà tàbí kú.
Zulu: Futhi, umehluko ekuhlolweni kwelebhu wawungase ube nemiphumela ehlanekezelwe, futhi abakwazanga ukulandisa ngeziguli ezilahlekile ezaziyekile noma zashintsha imishanguzo, noma ezashona.
Hausa: Haka nan, bambance-bambance a cikin gwaje-gwajen ɗakin gwaji yana iya haifar da sakamako mai banƙyama, kuma ba za su iya yin lissafin ɓacewar marasa lafiya da suka daina ko canza magani, ko kuma suka mutu ba.
Northern Sotho: Gape, diphapano mabapi le diteko tša ka laporathoring di ka be di ile tša phamoša dipoelo, gomme ga se ba kgona go hwetša balwetši bao ba lahlegilego bao ba emišitšego goba ba fetotšego goba ba fetšitšego kalafo, goba ba hlokofetšego.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ በላብራቶሪ ምርመራዎች ላይ ያሉ ልዩነቶች ውጤቶቹን የተዛቡ ሊያደርጓቸው ይችላሉ፤ እንዲሁም ህክምና ያቆሙ ወይም የሞቱ በሽተኞችን ከግምት ውስጥ ሊያስገቡ አልቻሉም።

English: The researchers say that without CD4 testing and expanded viral load testing, patients who have advanced HIV disease, or patients for whom treatment doesn’t work, may go undetected, which undermines the success of antiretroviral therapy in southern Africa.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti awatali kukebera CD4 n’okukebera omuwendo gw’akawuka, abalwadde abalina HIV akuze, oba abalwadde eddagala be litakolako, bayinza obutazuulwa, ekikosa enkola y’eddagala eriweweeza ku HIV mu bukiikaddyo bwa Afirika.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ èyí láìsí àyẹ̀wò CD4 àti àyẹ̀wò ìwọn kòkòrò fáírọ́ọ̀sì inú ẹ̀jẹ̀ tó fẹjú, àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní ààrun HIV tí ipò rẹ̀ ga àti àwọn aláìsàn tí ìtọ́jú wọn kò ṣiṣẹ́, lè wà láìṣàwárí wọn, léyìí tí ó bu àṣeyọrí ìtọ́jú lọ́wọ́ kòkòrò fáírọ́ọ̀sì ní ìhà gúúsù Áfíríkà kù.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi ngaphandle kokuhlolwa kwe-CD4 nokuhlolwa kwenani legciwane egazini okwandisiwe, iziguli ezinesifo se-HIV esithuthukisiwe, noma iziguli ezingakusebenzeli ukwelashwa, zingase zingabonwa, okwehlisa impumelelo yokwelashwa ngezidambisigciwane eningizimu ye-Afrika.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce ba tare da gwajin CD4 ba da kuma gwajin yawan ƙwayar cuta da aka faɗaɗa ba, marasa lafiya da suka ci gaba da cutar HIV ko marasa lafiya waɗanda jiyyarsu ba ta aiki, suna iya wucewa ba tare da an gano su ba, wanda haka yake lalata nasarar maganin cutar ƙanjamau a kudancin Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore ka ntle le teko ya CD4 le teko ya morwalo wa dibaerase ye e katološitšwego, balwetši bao ba nago le bolwetši bja HIV bjo bo kekilego, goba balwetši bao kalafo e sa šomego go bona, bolwetši bo ka ba gona bo sa bonwe, gomme se se šitiša katlego ya kalafo ka dianthiretherobaerale ka Borwa bja Afrika.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደሚሉት ያለ ሲዲ4 እና የተስፋፋ የቫይረስ ሸክም ምርመራ የጠና የኤችአይቪ በሽታ ያለባቸው ታማሚዎች ወይም ህክምና ያለሰራላቸው ታማሚዎች ሳይታወቁ ሊቀሩ ይችላሉ፤ ይህም በደቡብ አፍሪካ የጸረ ኤችአይቪ ህክምና ስኬታማነትን ሊያዳክም ይችላል።

English: The authors of this paper were from Africa, the United States and the United Kingdom.
Luganda: Abawandiisi b’olupapula luno baali bava mu Afirika, Amerika ne Bungereza.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí jẹ́ láti ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà, United State àti United Kingdom.
Zulu: Ababhali baleli phepha bebevela e-Afrika, e-United States nase-United Kingdom.
Hausa: Mawallafan wannan takarda sun fito ne daga Afirka da Amurka da kuma Ingila.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba pampiri ye ba be ba etšwa ka Afrika, United States le United Kingdom.
